skill_name: Identify any potential security risks related to the use of internet-connected devices.
workflow: The use of internet-connected devices presents a variety of security risks. Firstly, these devices can be vulnerable to malicious cyber-attacks, as cybercriminals can exploit their weak security measures to gain access to private data. Additionally, these devices can be used to launch distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks and spam campaigns.
